metadata.title: MDO user-reported phishing - Sentinel playbooks
metadata.description: Workaround for the View submission null Item ID on the Email reported by user as malware or phish alert: posts the reported email status (reporter, Microsoft analysis, analyst verdict) with a working Open in Submissions link on each incident, and lets analysts mark reported emails as No threats found, Phishing or Spam and notify the reporter from Run playbook.
Resource group of the Sentinel workspace. Keep the default only if the workspace is in the resource group you're deploying to.
Name prefix for the four playbooks.
Region for the playbooks and the Sentinel API connection.

Object ID of Microsoft Sentinel's service account, the Azure Security Insights enterprise application. Get it in Cloud Shell: az ad sp show --id 98785600-1bb7-4fb9-b9fa-19afe2c8a360 --query id -o tsv. Sentinel then gets Microsoft Sentinel Automation Contributor on this resource group, so Run playbook and automation rules can start the playbooks. Leave empty if Sentinel already has Playbook permissions on this resource group.

Create the two automation rules that run the Details playbook automatically. Leave false on the first deployment. A few minutes later, deploy again with true: Sentinel can only create the rules once its permission on this resource group has taken effect.
Create the automation rules enabled (true) or disabled (false).
Order for the automation rules (the second rule uses order + 1).

tags.Purpose: Posts a short status comment for each reported email (analyst verdict, Microsoft analysis, sender, reporter) with an Open in Submissions link

Result_text.inputs: @coalesce(json('{"beingAnalyzed":"In progress","notJunk":"No threats found","noThreatsFound":"No threats found","phishing":"Phishing","spam":"Spam","malware":"Malware","threatsFound":"Threats found","phishingSimulation":"Phishing simulation","allowedByPolicy":"Allowed by policy","blockedByPolicy":"Blocked by policy","spoof":"Spoof","noResultAvailable":"No result available","notSubmittedToMicrosoft":"Not submitted to Microsoft","unknown":"Unknown"}')?[coalesce(first(body('Matching_report'))?['result']?['category'], 'none')], first(body('Matching_report'))?['result']?['category'], 'Not available')

Review_text.inputs: @if(equals(first(body('Matching_report'))?['adminReview'], null), 'Not reviewed yet', concat('', coalesce(json('{"notJunk":"No threats found","phishing":"Phishing","spam":"Spam","malware":"Malware"}')?[coalesce(first(body('Matching_report'))?['adminReview']?['reviewResult'], 'none')], first(body('Matching_report'))?['adminReview']?['reviewResult'], '?'), ' (set by ', if(contains(coalesce(first(body('Matching_report'))?['adminReview']?['reviewBy'], ''), '@'), first(body('Matching_report'))?['adminReview']?['reviewBy'], 'a playbook'), if(empty(coalesce(first(body('Matching_report'))?['adminReview']?['reviewDateTime'], '')), '', concat(' on ', formatDateTime(first(body('Matching_report'))?['adminReview']?['reviewDateTime'], 'MMM d, HH:mm'), ' UTC')), ')'))

Status_comment.inputs:
@concat('

Reported email: ', outputs('Subject_html'), '
', 'Analyst verdict: ', outputs('Review_text'), '
', 'Microsoft analysis: ', outputs('Result_text'), '
', 'Sender: ', outputs('Sender_html'), '
', 'Reported by: ', outputs('Reporter_html'), ' on ', formatDateTime(first(body('Matching_report'))?['createdDateTime'], 'MMM d, HH:mm'), ' UTC (as ', if(equals(first(body('Matching_report'))?['category'], 'spam'), 'junk', if(equals(first(body('Matching_report'))?['category'], 'notJunk'), 'not junk', coalesce(first(body('Matching_report'))?['category'], 'unknown'))), if(equals(first(body('Matching_report'))?['attackSimulationInfo'], null), '', '; attack simulation'), ')
', 'Open in Submissions

')

inputs.select:
@concat('

Reported email: ', replace(replace(replace(coalesce(item()?['properties']?['subject'], '(no subject)'), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '
Received by: ', replace(replace(replace(coalesce(item()?['properties']?['recipient'], 'unknown'), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '
Details are not available right now.
Open in Submissions

')

tags.Purpose: Marks the reported emails in the incident as No threats found and notifies the reporters

inputs.name: Results
inputs.value: @concat('', replace(replace(replace(coalesce(first(body('Matching_report'))?['subject'], '(no subject)'), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), ': not marked (HTTP ', string(outputs('Mark_and_notify')?['statusCode']), '). Try again, or use Open in Submissions.')

inputs.name: Results
inputs.value: @concat('Alert ', coalesce(items('For_each_alert')?['properties']?['providerAlertId'], 'unknown'), ': no single matching report (', string(length(body('Matching_report'))), ' found). Use Open in Submissions.')

body.message:
@if(not(equals(actions('List_user_reports')?['status'], 'Succeeded')), concat('

No action taken
The playbook could not read the reported emails (HTTP ', string(coalesce(outputs('List_user_reports')?['statusCode'], 'unknown')), '). Check its Microsoft Graph permission, or use Open in Submissions.

'), if(greater(length(variables('Results')), 0), concat('

Verdict: ', parameters('VerdictLabel'), '
', join(variables('Results'), '
'), if(greater(length(variables('Skipped')), 0), concat('
', concat('Already reviewed (left unchanged, no email sent): ', join(variables('Skipped'), ', '))), ''), '

'), if(greater(length(variables('Skipped')), 0), concat('

Verdict: ', parameters('VerdictLabel'), ' (no change)
', concat('Already reviewed (left unchanged, no email sent): ', join(variables('Skipped'), ', ')), '

'), '

No action taken
This incident has no Email reported by user alerts.

')))
